overall_rationale: No must need is unmet, so the overall verdict is feasible_with_conditions. N1 (must) is met with conditions by the internal station table for production and the UCI file for prototype. N3 (must) is met with conditions by Open-Meteo for both windows and by the ARPA temperature file as a prototype benchmark. N2 (must, production) is only partially met: the traffic counts cannot yet be linked to stations and change basis on 2024-03-18. The must needs drive the conditional verdict: they depend on access approvals (Environment Monitoring Unit, Clinical Analytics, Mobility Office), Legal sign-off for production use of Open-Meteo, a research-only restriction on the UCI file, and a counter-to-station mapping. N4 (should) is met with conditions. N5 and N6 (could) are unmet and do not affect the overall verdict. The Chicago link is not feasible on geography, licence and reachability. The Eurostat link is not feasible for the proposed windows.
